question: How many customers are there?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t2s_sample.customers

question: List all genre names.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM t2s_sample.genres

question: What is the current weather in Paris?
gold_sql: SELECT 1 WHERE false

question: What is the email address of the customer whose id is 5?
gold_sql: SELECT email FROM t2s_sample.customers WHERE id = 5

question: List each album title together with the name of its artist.
gold_sql: SELECT al.title, ar.name FROM t2s_sample.albums al JOIN t2s_sample.artists ar ON ar.id = al.artist_id

question: How many albums does each artist have?
gold_sql: SELECT artist_id, COUNT(*) FROM t2s_sample.albums GROUP BY artist_id

question: Show me the revenue.
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(total) FROM t2s_sample.invoices

question: How many invoices were created in 2023?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t2s_sample.invoices WHERE invoice_date >= '2023-01-01' AND invoice_date < '2024-01-01'

question: What is the total revenue for each billing country?
gold_sql: SELECT billing_country, SUM(total) FROM t2s_sample.invoices GROUP BY billing_country

question: How many tracks belong to the genre called Rock?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t2s_sample.tracks t JOIN t2s_sample.genres g ON g.id = t.genre_id WHERE g.name = 'Rock'

question: How many tracks are in the database?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t2s_sample.tracks

question: How many customers are there in each country?
gold_sql: SELECT country, COUNT(*) FROM t2s_sample.customers GROUP BY country

question: What is the total revenue in 2024?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(total) FROM t2s_sample.invoices WHERE invoice_date >= '2024-01-01' AND invoice_date < '2025-01-01'

question: List every employee's first name along with their manager's first name.
gold_sql: SELECT e.first_name, m.first_name FROM t2s_sample.employees e LEFT JOIN t2s_sample.employees m ON m.id = e.reports_to

question: What is the average track duration in seconds for each genre?
gold_sql: SELECT g.name, AVG(t.duration_seconds) FROM t2s_sample.tracks t JOIN t2s_sample.genres g ON g.id = t.genre_id GROUP BY g.name

question: Which 5 customers have spent the most in total? Return customer id and amount, highest first.
gold_sql: SELECT customer_id, SUM(total) AS spent FROM t2s_sample.invoices GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY spent DESC LIMIT 5

question: What are the first and last names of customer number 5?
gold_sql: SELECT first_name, last_name FROM t2s_sample.customers WHERE id = 5

question: List the id, first name and last name of customers who signed up in 2022.
gold_sql: SELECT id, first_name, last_name FROM t2s_sample.customers WHERE signup_date >= '2022-01-01' AND signup_date < '2023-01-01'

question: Which distinct countries do customers come from?
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT country FROM t2s_sample.customers

question: Which genre has the most tracks? Return the genre name and the count.
gold_sql: SELECT g.name, COUNT(*) AS c FROM t2s_sample.tracks t JOIN t2s_sample.genres g ON g.id = t.genre_id GROUP BY g.name ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 1

question: List the names of tracks that appear on albums released in 2020.
gold_sql: SELECT t.name FROM t2s_sample.tracks t JOIN t2s_sample.albums a ON a.id = t.album_id WHERE a.release_year = 2020

question: How many employees were hired before 2019?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t2s_sample.employees WHERE hire_date < '2019-01-01'

question: Which artists are from Canada?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM t2s_sample.artists WHERE country = 'Canada'

question: What is the total quantity of tracks sold per genre?
gold_sql: SELECT g.name, SUM(il.quantity) FROM t2s_sample.invoice_lines il JOIN t2s_sample.tracks t ON t.id = il.track_id JOIN t2s_sample.genres g ON g.id = t.genre_id GROUP BY g.name

question: How many distinct tracks has each customer purchased?
gold_sql: SELECT i.customer_id, COUNT(DISTINCT il.track_id) FROM t2s_sample.invoices i JOIN t2s_sample.invoice_lines il ON il.invoice_id = i.id GROUP BY i.customer_id

question: Which album titles were released between 2010 and 2015 inclusive?
gold_sql: SELECT title FROM t2s_sample.albums WHERE release_year BETWEEN 2010 AND 2015

question: What is the highest track unit price?
gold_sql: SELECT MAX(unit_price) FROM t2s_sample.tracks

question: List each artist name and how many tracks they have across all their albums.
gold_sql: SELECT ar.name, COUNT(t.id) FROM t2s_sample.artists ar JOIN t2s_sample.albums al ON al.artist_id = ar.id JOIN t2s_sample.tracks t ON t.album_id = al.id GROUP BY ar.name

question: Who are our top artists?
gold_sql: SELECT ar.name, COUNT(t.id) AS c FROM t2s_sample.artists ar JOIN t2s_sample.albums al ON al.artist_id = ar.id JOIN t2s_sample.tracks t ON t.album_id = al.id GROUP BY ar.name ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 5

question: How many sales did we have?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t2s_sample.invoices

question: How many songs were streamed on Spotify last month?
gold_sql: SELECT 1 WHERE false

question: What is the profit margin on each album?
gold_sql: SELECT 1 WHERE false
